entries.headline: RSD308 Il-96-300 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Russian Special Flight Squadron Ilyushin Il-96-300 RSD308, registration RA-96018 and hex 157712. The sighting was credited to jessidavin; the visible route description was truncated after “from…”

entries.headline: AFFA30 E-6B Mercury sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of an E-6B Mercury with no call sign and hex AFFA30, reported as departing Travis Air Force Base. The sighting was credited to jessidavin.

entries.headline: Meduza report on Moscow security warning highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Meduza report, saying it preceded a wire report by 10 minutes and had been confirmed by two outlets. The visible quotation said the U.S. Embassy in Moscow had warned of a mass-casualty threat at Tsaritsyno, but was truncated after the location name.

entries.headline: U.S. Embassy Moscow threat report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report, credited to @iamthelolrus, that the U.S. Embassy in Moscow was aware of a credible mass-casualty threat for 31 October at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve. The visible post was truncated after the location reference.

entries.headline: Elevated U.S. transport-aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, describing the number as well above typical levels for that time. It reported that no coded radio broadcasts were detected during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: AE0692 KC-135 Stratotanker sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of KC-135 Stratotanker registration 63-7997, hex AE0692, with no call sign, circling over the West Palm Beach temporary flight restriction. The sighting was credited to JessiDavin.

entries.headline: Sustained U.S. transport-aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft observed across the Atlantic and North Sea during the preceding hour, describing this as part of sustained heavy airlift activity during recent hours.

entries.headline: Al Jazeera report on Iranian threat response highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report, saying it preceded a wire report by 26 minutes and had been confirmed by two outlets. The visible quotation, attributed to Iran’s Supreme Leader and addressed to armed-forces commanders, was truncated after “any kind of threat must be…”

entries.headline: Six U.S. transport aircraft and no coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the North Atlantic and continental United States during the preceding hour, crediting RobertChester-j5b. It reported that no coded broadcasts were detected.

entries.headline: U.S. military-air and coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and one surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States. It said coded radio traffic had been quiet during the preceding hour, with the latest signal reported 12 hours earlier.

entries.headline: Elevated North Sea and North American military-air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported military-air activity over the North Sea at nearly five times normal. It also reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and one surveillance aircraft airborne over North America; the visible post was truncated after “North America…”

entries.headline: SAM564 C-37B sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of U.S. Air Force 89th Airlift Wing Gulfstream C-37B SAM564, hex AE6961, associated in the post with Andrews Air Force Base. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: Signature Access FBO pricing changes examined
entries.summary: SkyGlass said Signature Access prices core fixed-base-operator access by aircraft size, ramp time and location, while limiting event fees from 2027. It argued that ramp dwell time and demand are operational variables FBOs should track, citing RampWatch as a way to show them.

entries.headline: BACE2026 four-field business-jet total revisited
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that 1,040 distinct business jets moved through four Las Vegas fields during BACE2026 show week. It said the RampWatch board prompted conversations, including direct-message feedback that ramp personnel wanted views of their own traffic, and linked to a replay.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.

entries.headline: BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 259 departures from four Las Vegas-area fields by 1:43 p.m. ET, compared with 116 arrivals, and shared a time-lapse covering 10:17 a.m. to 1:29 p.m. ET.

entries.headline: BACE departure and arrival counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 120 departures and 48 arrivals across four Las Vegas fields by 12:15 p.m. ET on Thursday during BACE2026, and shared a 30-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Thursday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity up 10% while overall Las Vegas valley traffic fell 3% on Thursday compared with Wednesday, and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: Las Vegas field departure count reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 243 aircraft still on the ground across four Las Vegas fields at 10:16 a.m. ET Friday, with 61 already departed.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE peak-hour replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay covering 28 minutes of Wednesday’s NBAA-BACE peak traffic across Harry Reid, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Boulder City, followed by a valley-wide view.

entries.headline: N871CB Boulder City arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared the Wednesday NBAA-BACE arrival of Citation CJ2 N871CB into Boulder City, showing the approach at ten-times speed and the touchdown in real time.
